mapping_stack.transport: PMTiles v3 MVT over local HTTP Range

files.changes: Local pinned dependencies and glyphs; actual Protomaps layer schema; removed online style fallback, unrelated ENC overlay and suppressed source errors; region-bound view; preserved window.m control convention.
Static map-root server without Electron; exact single-range parsing, realpath containment and stream error handling.

local_evolution.geometry_fix: Restore polygon-only predicates on earth, landuse and water fills. River LineStrings were being closed and filled as triangles. Rivers now use a separate line layer; the source tile archive is unchanged.
local_evolution.marine_order: Ocean background, regional MSL depth contours and labels, land fills, inland-water polygons, then coast/roads/labels and recorded aids. Ocean fill is omitted because the background already supplies its colour.
local_evolution.navigation_scope: Browser-local illustrative source observations and fault controls; not ASPN transport, a shared MCP service, RF diagnosis, or an accuracy/integrity assessment.

not_imported: wind/current, routing, radio, telemetry and credentials
license_note: Meridian-derived code is reused internally for DeepBlueDynamics. The inspected extraction reports no project LICENSE; no open-source licence is asserted. Third-party notices are in vendor/. Tile provenance is in hormuz.manifest.json.
disclaimer: Geographic context demonstrator only; not an ENC, navigation chart, or ECDIS.
